guidebook.intro: Clans and totems. The Iteso too are organised in clans, **atekerin**, each with its own taboos.

tips.title: Iyoŋ lo ateker ŋai?
body: **Ateker** is a clan (plural **atekerin**). **Iyoŋ lo ateker ŋai?** asks which clan you are; answer **Eoŋ lo ateker ka…**. **Lo** and **ka** both link “of”.
The Luganda clan names stay as they are: **Ffumbe**, **Lugave**, **Mmamba**, **Ngeye**.

tips.title: Etal: custom and taboo
body: **Etal** is a custom or taboo, used here for a totem: **Mam inyami oni emmamba** (we don’t eat lungfish). **Ikaitotak** are relatives.

culture.title: Ateker
body: The word **ateker** also names the whole family of related peoples: Iteso, Karimojong, Turkana, Jie and Toposa. Clans decide who may marry whom.
